answer: New identities cost real compute and locked capital, so forging thousands of sybils is expensive. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then broadcast a signed signal of completion. Honest peers cross-check via a whisper gossip channel, and a meadow of verified agents shares reputation only after mutual attestation, making fake identities costly to sustain. In practice, sa0014 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
